implementation.continuity: The parent process restarts the owner, builds the same canonical source, and writes through the existing ordinary writeback and admission owner. Earlier receipt-substitution rejection remains covered.
implementation.interruption: The child exits after publishing latest.json and before cognition/writeback. A second process at a later tick reconstructs the same run and reprojects identical source ID, source digest, fact ID, and payload digest.
implementation.no_promotion: Developmental-history bytes remain unchanged across both projection processes; the persisted World-State record carries no admission authority.
implementation.projection: A fresh child process reconstructs exact invocation and serving receipt custody, recovers the aggregate run, and invokes the daemon’s normal RuntimeMaintenanceSurfaces World-State builder.
implementation.scope: Invocation outputs and source receipts are fixtures. This verifies projection/recovery composition, not model behavior, physical observation, or acquired real-world competence.

objective: Exercise a process interruption after completed objective-run recovery and durable World-State publication but before developmental writeback.
